text: Took it camping in the Dolomites. Real crema with a fine grind, very compact, fits in my backpack side pocket.
Great shots once you learn the pumping rhythm. Takes about 15 pumps. Cleanup is quick with the brush.
Water tank is small, only one shot at a time. You need to bring pre-heated water, it does not heat water itself.
Dripped a little from the capsule adapter the first week until I seated the gasket properly.
Use it daily at the office. Capsule adapter works with my Nespresso-compatible pods. No batteries is a big plus.
Pressure is real, the shots are rich. Instructions could be clearer about grind size.
Hiked 4 days on the Via Dinarica without washing, they stayed surprisingly fresh. Merino is the real deal.
Cushioning under the heel is perfect for long descents. No hot spots in my boots.
Sizing runs a bit large, I am EU 42 and M was slightly long at the toe.
Got a small hole at the toe after 3 months of daily use. Customer service replaced them though.
Warm in winter, not too hot in spring. Arch band keeps them from sliding down.
Shrank slightly when I dried them on high heat. Follow the care label.
Color accuracy is great for photo editing, the warm mode is pleasant in the evening. No visible flicker on camera.
Wireless charging pad is handy for my phone. App setup took two tries on my 5 GHz-only network, needed 2.4 GHz.
Touch panel is very sensitive, I keep changing brightness by accident when I reach for my phone.
Bright enough to light the whole desk. Arm is sturdy and stays where you put it.
Base is large and takes up desk space. Light quality is excellent though.
Works with Google Home routines, I schedule warm light after 9pm. My eyes feel less tired late at night.
